integrity: The exact-rational standalone test is supplementary; the infinite argument uses positive compact-Jacobi interlacing, principal-minor summation and a partition generating-function bound. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed strictly contractive radial symbols and two-tap analytic polynomial weights only. Exact individual singular-value formula, uniform parameter asymptotics and critical 1/n coefficient are not claimed. Specialized priority risk remains.
title: A Mahler-measure singular-value law and critical excess transition for two-tap Hardy dilations
